findings.requiredRepair: Validate exact open draft PR repository/base/head/expected-parent identity, or absence of any initial PR collision, before Git mutations. Retain post-write validation and original uncertain-write reconciliation. Add zero-write controls for closed, ready, and historical-collision cases.
